# Asset Format Fixtures

`embedded_dds.fbx` is an original binary FBX 7.4 regression fixture authored for these tests, licensed under the repository's MIT license. It contains one triangle at `(0,0,0)`, `(1,0,0)`, `(0,1,0)`, one material and an embedded 4x4 BC1 sRGB DDS image. The image's RGB565 endpoint is `0x8410`; every pixel selects that endpoint. Its referenced filename deliberately does not exist, so an importer cannot pass by loading an external texture.

The fixture exercises OpenFBX's binary `Content` property, whose data view includes the four-byte length prefix. Other fixtures are generated by `asset_formats.cpp` in the ignored test output directory.
